name: Suzuki GSX-R600
engine: 599 cc liquid-cooled inline four, carbs (1997-2000) or fuel injected
intro: Suzuki's middleweight GSX-R. 2004-2010 bikes are in a big front brake master cylinder recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2004-2010 bikes are in recall 13V449 (front brake master cylinder). 2008-2010 bikes are in recall 16V018 (regulator/rectifier).
A-002.reason: A weak front brake is a crash risk. Both fixes are free.

G: 1997-2000 bikes have carbs. 2001-on bikes are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match.

recalls.what: Gas can form in the front brake master cylinder and reduce braking.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the front master cylinder free.

recalls.what: Regulator/rectifier circuit board can lift off its case, causing a stall or no-start.
